_comment: Deployment Rules for DeployPipeline — configure in Fabric UI: Pipeline → ⚙️ Deployment Rules on the target stage. Rules can't be imported from a file; this is the reference for what to enter.

rules.description: PL_Refresh_Master resolves its workspace at runtime via @pipeline().DataFactory, so no WorkspaceId rule is needed. Set only the Environment flag and the per-stage item GUIDs below. Item GUIDs come from each workspace (item -> Settings, or the item URL).
Binds the semantic model to the stage-appropriate Gold_LH SQL endpoint

_howto: 1. Open DeployPipeline in the Fabric portal
2. Click the Deployment Rules gear on the target (Production) stage
3. For PL_Refresh_Master add Parameter rules for Environment + the five item-GUID parameters
4. For Gold_SM add a Data source rule pointing at that stage's Gold_LH SQL endpoint
5. Rules are stored on the pipeline and applied automatically on every deploy (including GitHub Actions deploys)
TIP: Promote all items in the SAME deploy so Fabric auto-pairs them; paired notebooks/dataflow/model keep their bindings and the GUID rules become a safety net, not a requirement
